reviews.title: App keeps crashing
reviews.text: I pay for this app yearly, but it stopped working a few weeks ago. I’ve tried restarting my phone, deleting and reinstalling the app, and restoring my information but nothing has worked. I’ve also contacted customer support twice and have yet to receive a response. It’s frustrating to continue paying for an app that doesn’t work, especially when I haven’t received any help resolving the issue.

reviews.title: Help
reviews.text:
Assalamu Alaikum
I really want to use this app but whenever i download the app and i click for the free version and press x on the trial, my app crashes. after some time, the alp loads up and its just black.
if there is any way for you guys to fix this i’d immensely appreciate it!

reviews.title: Aggravating
reviews.text: All I get is a black screen when I go into the app I saw all the good reviews on it and no one seems to have the same issue as I am and I paid for the app as well so I’m a little annoyed I can’t even used or see what it has to offer me as a new Muslim
